title: Brain Region Mapping
hint: Click a colored region on the brain
guideStudy: Click any lobe on the brain (or a button) to learn its job. Try all 6 regions!
guideQuiz: Read the question, then click the matching brain region. Wrong answers show the right one.
guideMission: Find all 3 main brain parts: cerebrum, cerebellum, and brain stem. Tap regions to discover them!
guideScenario: Click the brain part that keeps you balanced, then the one that plans your route. Either order works!
guideCorrect: Nice! Keep going — next question is ready.
guideWrong: Not that one — watch the glowing region light up, that's the right answer!
celebrateMission: Mission complete! You found all 3 main brain parts. ★
celebrateQuiz: Quiz mastered! Every region answered correctly. ★★
celebrateScenario: Balance + planning — that's how you ride safely! ★
learnMore: Remember: the four lobes belong to the cerebrum. Cerebellum = balance. Brain stem = automatic life functions.
scenarioPrompt: Which parts help you balance & plan while riding?
